forms hydronium ions only in very dilute solutions. | | **Oxidation states** | +1 (most common, e.g., HF, HCl), -1 (hydride, e.g., NaH), rarely 0 (elemental H₂). | | **Reactivity** | Highly reactive metal-like element;
